decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the established offer, was visibly presented on its own page and fits the announced consumer health expansion, so management stays committed despite missing recent observations.
The skin and hair supplement was publicly launched as new in pharmacies and belongs to the core consumer health line, so its visibility and strategic fit favor persistence.
As part of the established Trivital brand with a public launch announcement, the joint supplement is a cheap line extension that management would justify keeping.

The mushroom immune supplement had only low visibility, but as a low-cost extension of the supplement line, and with immune products in demand during the pandemic, there is little reason to withdraw it.

Despite the 2018 contamination recall, the problem can be attributed to a temporary supplier issue and generics broadening is part of the announced direction, so management likely re-sourced rather than exited, though the product remains distant from the core.
The OTC triptan was presented on its own page as a visible step into new consumer health territory, so the public commitment and strategic centrality favor keeping it even though results are unknown.
